piece: The experience instrument and the seam crossings
progress: Read RULES.md, INDEX.md, PLAN.md W1-25, RI-CMP01, RI-EXP02, RI-EXP06.
CONFIRMED ABSENT (rule 24 - must build): tools/composition/ entire directory, corpus/95-experience/RI-CMP01.cells.json, corpus/95-experience/RI-EXP06.probes.json, reports/composition/.

Existing tools/experience/ has 12 files (beat-*, ending-*, isolation-check, log-lint, ponr-probe, session-run, aftermath-diff, lib/). anecdote-verify.mjs, recall-run.mjs, breakage-probe.mjs, pbrule-audit.mjs, probes-from-md.mjs, matrix-scan.mjs, matrix-probe.mjs, cells-from-md.mjs ALL ABSENT.

DONE (1/4) THE SABOTAGE CONTROL. tools/experience/lib/sabotage.mjs is a general facility: caller supplies measure() + a list of breakable factors; the facility enumerates the full factorial, accounts for support, and FAILS WHEN THE ARMS AGREE. Five failing verdicts: INERT (arms agree), MASKED (moves only when all k guards are broken - no single-factor effect), VACUOUS (an arm ranged over zero units), UNDERPOWERED, WRONG_DIRECTION.

--self-test: 6/6 synthetic verdicts correct AND 3/3 deliberately injected defects in the facility itself caught (--break=comparator|support|factorial each makes the suite go red; exit 0 only when it does).

--cases: 8/8. Replays the three real failures from artifacts on disk. w1-04 collision pre-fix verb -> INERT (67==67 in 5 towns), shipped verb -> OK (67->0). w1-souls one-factor delete-the-fix -> INERT twice, the 2x2 factorial -> MASKED naming {identity,boundary} as the minimal breaking set. w1-13 night-roster -> VACUOUS (control arm roster_n 0), and the merchants clause from the SAME run -> OK (115 shops in both arms).

DONE (2/4, offline half) RI-CMP01. tools/composition/ built from nothing: cells-from-md.mjs generates corpus/95-experience/RI-CMP01.cells.json from the item and INDEPENDENTLY RECOUNTS every declared total. All of them hold: 342 off-diagonal cells, 206 non-none (60.2%), m146 S19 M38 T3, trivial 15, none 121, 41 crossings splitting 30 W-to-F / 11 F-to-W, 22 structural, declared matrix score 297. Its --self-test mutates a COPY of the item four ways and requires the generator to go red on each: 4/4.

FINDING (RI-CMP01 as written): 24 of the 342 cells' crossing status turns on a qualifier in §A that a machine cannot decide ('DUN-as-arena', 'beyond souls and corpses'). Five of them satisfy §A's F-to-W shape outright and are still not marked crossings: ROS->GLD, ROS->LOR, BOS->GLD, BOS->WEA, BOS->JRN. Named in the artifact as direction_judgements rather than silently agreed with.

FINDING (the build): matrix-scan over 563 data files finds a data-path claim for 30 cells, and only 4 of the 41 declared seam crossings have ANY data behind them at all - SPL->ROS, SPL->DUN, DIS->BOS, ROS->WLD. 37 crossing cells have no data claim of any kind. --self-test deletes a whole class of evidence (world_flags, faction_reputation, souls, knowledge gates) and requires the cell to fall to zero: 4/4.

matrix-probe.mjs built and its --self-test passes 10 probes x 3 known fake worlds (live/paper/empty -> OK/INERT/VACUOUS). The live A/B fork run is BLOCKED ON CONTENTION: gate exit 3 at 5 browser instances, load 6.3 per core against a 4.0 ceiling. Nothing is demonstrated yet and the report says so.

NOTE ON ATTRIBUTION: parts 2 and 3 were swept into the orchestrator's bank commits (9288ebf, 6ff493f) while I was waiting on .git/index.lock. The files are on the tree; the commit messages are not mine. Recorded per rule 26.

DONE (3/4) RI-EXP06. probes-from-md.mjs generates corpus/95-experience/RI-EXP06.probes.json from the register: 15 entries, 15 live, 8 systemic, 2 permanent, 1 conditional, 40 assertions, 13 carrying a 'Red if' close clause. Self-test 4/4 (strike four entries below the floor of twelve; remove a Sys marker; delete a probe paragraph; delete an entry).

breakage-probe.mjs runs each entry's own 'Red if' clause as a closure detector over game/data + game/src, reporting SUBSTRATE and CLOSURE separately. 13 live, 2 unmeasurable (B-07 the Scrolls of the Drowned Step are not in the tree; B-10 there is no enemy at boss tier for a parley to end). Self-test injects each entry's own closing mechanism and requires the detector to fire: 15/15.

Its first run produced THREE false CLOSED verdicts, all recorded in the file: PARLEY_EXEMPT is seam S13 working correctly for beasts; 'filled gems unsellable' is the soul-gem economy not an is_quest_item block; and keying 'boss' off an id regex matched drowned_greater on the letters 'great', reporting a tier-trash Deep-Drowned as a boss with no parley.

DURABILITY DEMONSTRATED: --demo-regression=B-12 injects an is_quest_item sell block in memory only, B-12 goes pass->fail, the diff returns REGRESSION and exit 2 (hard fail 4). The baseline the next wave diffs against is committed at reports/experience/breakage-register-baseline.json.
pbrule-audit.mjs: 136 of 145 reference items carry anti-exploit language in a scoring context; 0 carry a preserves: line. PB-RULE is binding project-wide and has never been enforced. Self-test 4/4.

DONE (4/4) RI-EXP02 + RI-EXP03. anecdote-trace.mjs measures a session's CAPACITY to be recalled (A1 shape + A2 proper noun + A4 locatable) and labels itself as not being verified_anecdotes_per_hour. Self-test 5/5, the load-bearing arm being that 4000 frames of combat with no consequence must score ZERO.

HEADLINE FINDING: the only recorded session on this tree - reports/sessions/exp-w1-opening/trace.jsonl, 36,000 frames, ten simulated minutes, 82 MB - contains ZERO events. The three journey traces carry FIVE events each across 3,780 frames, all boot-time input plumbing. verified_anecdotes_per_hour is 0 by construction on every trace this project has ever recorded; RI-EXP02 hard fail 1 is < 1.5 and makes the wave DEAD.

SAB-P RAN AND SEPARATED. anecdote-verify.mjs implements RI-EXP02 §E (locate/resolve/class/score, verified minus unverified so silence is cheaper than invention) and step 6's MANDATORY sabotage control, as a real data filter through lib/sabotage.mjs: every journal entry, dialogue info and book passage cut to its own first sentence. 720 tellable passages -> 153, a drop of 78.75% against a required 50%. Verdict OK. Measured on the CONTENT CENSUS, not on a playthrough, and labelled so.

event-histogram.mjs (RI-EXP03 §B): on the same trace, 100% IDLE, H = 0 bits, unclassified_fraction 1.0 -> VOID, hard fail 7. A-EXP2 is 0 of 10 names present in game/src/sim/events.js, so READ/TRADE/CRAFT/MENU/TRAVEL_NODE are unmeasurable and collapse into IDLE exactly as the item says they must. Self-test 5/5.
The trace also carries no road-membership field, so TRANSIT and EXPLORE cannot be separated at all; reported as an absence rather than guessed.

MATRIX-PROBE, LIVE, ATTEMPT 1: ran in one browser (contention gate open), 10 cells, 6 INERT / 4 VACUOUS, 0 demonstrated crossings. THAT RUN IS VOID AND THE FAULT IS MINE. listEntities() returns {eid,kind,archetype,pos,hp} (engine.js:8764) and carries NO alert_state and NO side, so every alert-based probe compared '?' against '?' in both arms - an INERT verdict manufactured by the instrument. The piece caught itself with its own rule.

MATRIX-PROBE ATTEMPT 2: every alert probe rewritten onto getEncounterState(id).members[].alert_state, the only accessor in the build that carries it, with a real spawnEncounter() from game/data/world/encounters.json behind it. Self-test still 10/10 x 3 worlds. IT COULD NOT RUN: THE TREE DOES NOT BOOT AT HEAD. node tools/boot-check.mjs exits 12 - 'canon register: 2 unresolved reference(s) in game/data/lore/canon.json ... CF-D015/A: topic the-xanmeers has no info written for actor notary'. That is RULES #13, a fail-closed assertion landed ahead of its data, and it blocks EVERY browser measurement on this box. W1-25 has touched no file under game/.
matrix.json records ran:false. ZERO seam crossings demonstrated against a W1 floor of 4; RI-CMP01 hard fails 1 and 2 both fire.

RI-EXP02's real instrument: no playthrough chain, no 500-word baton bottleneck, no isolated M3 recalling agent, so verified_anecdotes_per_hour, the class floors T1-T5, arose_fraction, generic_fraction, confabulation_rate and mean_hops_survived are all UNMEASURED. recall-run.mjs is NOT built. The prompt is committed at corpus/95-experience/prompts/recall.md; nothing has ever been asked it.
RI-EXP02 step 5's blind pair (20 of our anecdotes against 20 constructed reference anecdotes) - not built, and per rule 25 I could not judge it anyway.

RI-EXP03's sag contract (SAG-1..SAG-7), shape invariants SH1-SH6, session beats SS1-SS6 and stop-point metrics: sag-fit.mjs, shape-check.mjs, session-beats.mjs and classes-from-md.mjs are NOT built. At FRAGMENT tier the sag contract is unmeasurable by the item's own tier scaling, and there is no chain to fit it to.
RI-EXP03 step 6's SAB-E control (encounters cloned) - not built. Only SAB-P was run.
RI-EXP06 Step 1 as the item means it: no probe PERFORMS its breakage in a running build. Every row is static_absence_of_closure and says so.
RI-EXP06 Step 4's playthrough cross-check (works_isolated_fails_in_chain) - null, no chain.

CONSUMPTION (RI-MTH07): I ship two models, corpus/95-experience/RI-CMP01.cells.json and RI-EXP06.probes.json. Both are INSTRUMENT data, not world models, and NOTHING IN THE RUNNING GAME READS EITHER. Their consumers are tools (matrix-probe.mjs, breakage-probe.mjs) and both are demonstrated by perturbation in the self-tests. I did not ship a world-side model, so the world-side consumption demonstration does not apply - stated here rather than papered over.
